novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanistic phenomenon: a compact circuit in which attention heads "write an 'uncertainty/keep-checking' direction" that reflection-token positions consume and thereby re-trigger, with targeted severing of this path breaking overthinking. Searches around "attention head feedback circuit overthinking reasoning models," "reflection token attention heads uncertainty," "mechanistic interpretability redundant self-verification," and "causal head gating chain-of-thought" identify CyclicReflex as the closest behavior-level work on regulating reflection-token logits, Trace Length is a Simple Uncertainty Signal in Reasoning Models as the closest uncertainty/length analysis, and Causal Head Gating as the closest sparse-head intervention framework, but none posits this recurrent head-to-reflection-token causal loop. Moving from those works to the claimed positive-feedback relationship requires a new core mechanistic hypothesis rather than a direct transfer, although its constituent measurements and head-gating intervention are established tools, placing it at the lower end of high novelty rather than paradigm-level novelty.
